dialogues.speaker: Lepine-Pauline
dialogues.text: #Ah, {NICKNAME}! Doesn't it feel like all your troubles just melt away when you're at Chevalmarin Film Fantasyland? I've got two pieces of good news for you! Which one would you like to hear first?

choices.text: Let's start with the most important one.

response.speaker: Lepine-Pauline
response.text: Alright! Then I'll begin with the one that's most exciting for you — I'm giving you the prototype of that Composite Hunter's Bow!

response.speaker: Player
response.text: The... prototype?

response.speaker: Lepine-Pauline
response.text: Many years ago, a weapon research team at the Fontaine Research Institute developed a prototype to push the limits of long-range bow performance. They hired my outsourcing team to design the sight for it.

response.speaker: Lepine-Pauline
response.text: But then, both the Maison Gardiennage and the Special Security and Surveillance Patrol adopted muskets as their standard issue, and stopped ordering bows in bulk since they require so much training to master.

response.speaker: Lepine-Pauline
response.text: The research team and my outsourcing group were disbanded, and this prototype ended up in my hands. Until recently...

response.speaker: Lepine-Pauline
response.text: A sci-fi film about "Mechanically Enhanced Warriors" borrowed that bow as a prop. The invisible protagonist, "The Prophet," used it to silently take down all sorts of enemies.

response.speaker: Lepine-Pauline
response.text: Thanks to that, the bow gained quite a following among sci-fi film fans, so I brought it here to showcase.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: What an interesting backstory...

response.speaker: Player
response.text: But why give it to me?

response.speaker: Lepine-Pauline
response.text: Because you're the heart and soul of Chevalmarin Film Fantasyland, the one who brings all these legendary characters together!

response.speaker: Lepine-Pauline
response.text: After fans learned about the bow's original purpose, they all hoped it could find its way into the hands of a true master, someone who could unleash its full potential.

response.speaker: Lepine-Pauline
response.text: As a renowned ace adventurer, even if you're not a bow expert yourself, I'm sure you'll find someone who can wield it with skill and bring out its true power!

response.speaker: Lepine-Pauline
response.text: Once things settle down at the Chevalmarin Film Fantasyland and most fans have had a chance to see it, I'd like you to take it and carry on its legacy beyond the silver screen!

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Wow, I'm so flattered.

response.speaker: Lepine-Pauline
response.text: Haha, no need for formalities between us. Just promise me you'll put it to good use! I hope you and your bow-wielding buddy have a blast with it!

choices.text: Hit me with the lighter one, please.

response.speaker: Lepine-Pauline
response.text: Haha, okay! So, I've finally escaped the wild ride of risky business ventures and landed some steady work!

response.speaker: Lepine-Pauline
response.text: Thanks to some inspiration from you and Miss Charlotte, I tweaked the Kamera Lens for Image Recognition Sample Collection and turned it into a high-precision zoom photography assistant.

response.speaker: Lepine-Pauline
response.text: The new-generation product hit the market right as Kamera lens was evolving, and now, many directors and merchants have started working with me!

response.speaker: Lepine-Pauline
response.text: I suppose you could say I'm a rising supplier in the film industry now. People trust my devices — that's why I was chosen to help build Chevalmarin Film Fantasyland.

response.speaker: Lepine-Pauline
response.text: Of course, my finances are still a bit unpredictable... but at least they're a lot more stable than before!

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Congratulations!

response.speaker: Lepine-Pauline
response.text: Same to you, same to you! I owe it all to you! One day, I'll treat you to a feast worth at least 280,000 Mora per meal!

choices.text: Save the celebration for me. We'll catch up later.

response.speaker: Lepine-Pauline
response.text: You got it! I'll keep the excitement on ice for you!

dialogues.speaker: Escoffier
dialogues.text: The fresh vegetables from the new batch are of exceptional quality. I just wish I could say the same about the new staff...

dialogues.speaker: Escoffier
dialogues.text: Mm, that unique aroma... I wonder how you'll inspire my cooking this time?

choices.text: Check the "theme dish."

response.speaker: Escoffier
response.text: Alright then, I'll just go with the flow. It's about time for a fresh new flavor.

choices.text: What's it like working here?

response.speaker: Escoffier
response.text: Hmm... I'd say it's quite similar to working at the tavern in the Fleuve Cendre.

response.speaker: Escoffier
response.text: There's something special about seeing diners' faces light up when they taste your food... You don't get that working in the closed-off kitchen in a grand hotel.

response.speaker: Escoffier
response.text: If something like this comes up again, just call me. Don't worry, we know each other. No commission fee needed — I won't take a single Mora.

choices.text: Thanks, Escoffier.

response.speaker: Escoffier
response.text: It's nothing. Just take care not to overwork yourself!

dialogues.speaker: Navia
dialogues.text: You've got this park off to a great start, partner! The ball's really starting to roll, huh?

dialogues.speaker: Navia
dialogues.text: Ah, I can't wait to see how it'll all turn out... Hehe, how exciting!

dialogues.speaker: Navia
dialogues.text: Our popularity's steadily rising, and our attractions just keep getting better!

dialogues.speaker: Navia
dialogues.text: I love the whole feel of the place, it's so fun! We should host more events like this in the future!

dialogues.speaker: Navia
dialogues.text: Our most recent financial report is looking great! This park's struck a chord with film buffs all over.

dialogues.speaker: Navia
dialogues.text: Maybe you could be our spokesperson next time we hold a similar event?

dialogues.speaker: Marine
dialogues.text: Hey there, Boss, look how hard I'm working! Could you see your way to upping my pay? That way, I can buy more gifts for Aeval.

choices.text: Aeval?

response.speaker: Marine
response.text: Yeah, she's the guide on the Clementine Line aquabus. We used to be colleagues.

response.speaker: Marine
response.text: For some reason, they transferred her away. Before she left, she would help me with all sorts of stuff — I've been looking for a way to thank her ever since.

response.speaker: Marine
response.text: But there's me, working away, and I never seem to have the time. It's only recently that I've finally gotten the chance for some recreation.

response.speaker: Marine
response.text: I originally asked Aeval to come with me, but she turned me down. She said something about "There's a big event going on, which means there'll be a lot of passengers to take care of"...

response.speaker: Marine
response.text: So I plan to get her some gifts instead!

choices.text: Why not Elphane?

response.speaker: Marine
response.text: Elphane? So you're familiar with the "Scarlet Specter"?

response.speaker: Marine
response.text: To be perfectly honest, I've never been her biggest fan. She used to take all the most prestigious jobs for herself — it made me look like I wasn't pulling my weight.

response.speaker: Marine
response.text: Shooting, fighting... Ahem... I mean, she's got almost perfect grades in all the main professional skills.

response.speaker: Marine
response.text: A talent like that, every time a holiday rolls around, she's sure to receive a deluge of gifts. She certainly doesn't need any more from me...

choices.text: Keep up the hard work!

response.speaker: Marine
response.text: Don't worry, I will! I'll approach this with the same vigor as though I was preparing for battle... Ahem, I mean, preparing for peaceful maritime labor!

dialogues.speaker: Helene
dialogues.text: He—Hello... Do you have a request for me?

choices.text: Take care of your mental well-being and enjoy your work!

response.speaker: Helene
response.text: I—Is that all？ There's no... 100-page set of requirements?

response.speaker: Helene
response.text: Phew... It looks like I've finally caught a break. A nice, easy assignment...

response.speaker: Helene
response.text: Although, at most, it might keep me busy for a couple of months... If only I could work here forever...

choices.text: I get the impression I intimidate you...

response.speaker: Helene
response.text: Oh, no, I'm not intimidated, just cautious! You know what they say... "Never upset the client." Haha...

response.speaker: Helene
response.text: Besides, given all the help you've lent me in the past, it's important that I show you the proper respect!

response.speaker: Helene
response.text: I can't afford to get fired again. The way the market is right now, it's not a good time to be looking for work as a freelance engineer...

response.speaker: Helene
response.text: I like this position. I'll work as hard as it takes to get the job done!

choices.text: Not really.

response.speaker: Helene
response.text: I—In that case, I won't disturb you. I should get back to my work...

response.speaker: Observe "Miss Gardemetiquette"
response.text: (The uniquely-named Gardemek appears to nod its head, signaling that everything is fine. You're not sure exactly why, but you're filled with a sense of relief.)

response.speaker: Observe "Miss Gardemetiquette"
response.text: (The uniquely-named Gardemek signals to you with a series of flashing components. You're unable to decipher its message...)

response.speaker: Observe "Miss Gardemetiquette"
response.text: (If you get the chance, you should ask the Maison Gardiennage to teach you how to communicate with the Gardemeks...)

choices.text: Sorry to bother you...

response.speaker: Observe "Miss Gardemetiquette"
response.text: (The uniquely-named Gardemek is no longer looking at you. Its focus has returned to its work. Who knows what problems it might encounter...)

dialogues.speaker: Bold Bang Bouldern
dialogues.text: Hey there! Great hero and magnificent leader, I await your command! How may I be of service?

choices.text: And you are...

response.speaker: Bold Bang Bouldern
response.text: I'm just a humble wrestler from the Collective of Plenty. I doubt you'd remember me, even if I introduced myself properly...

response.speaker: Bold Bang Bouldern
response.text: Which is why I've decided to style myself as "Utterly and Indisputably Vanquished Foe of the Mighty Varesa." At the very least, it should help me stand out from the crowd!

response.speaker: Bold Bang Bouldern
response.text: When Varesa was still only a few years old, she gave me an absolute pummeling. She picked me up one-handed and carried me out of the ring. How about that for a story, huh... Surely that's memorable enough?

choices.text: I command you to earn 10,000,000 Mora!

response.speaker: Bold Bang Bouldern
response.text: Wow, you must really believe in me! I'm not sure the whole park brings in that much money, let alone this one attraction...

response.speaker: Bold Bang Bouldern
response.text: I've been helping Varesa make deliveries for a good few years now, and I've never seen a transaction even close to that big!

response.speaker: Bold Bang Bouldern
response.text: As a boss, you must make a decent amount from dividends, right?

response.speaker: Bold Bang Bouldern
response.text: How about... you buy a 10-year membership at Coach Iansan's gym? Then buy the full set of ultimate courses. Trust me, that's a guaranteed winner right there!

choices.text: Just focus on doing a good job.

response.speaker: Bold Bang Bouldern
response.text: Understood! I won't let you down!

dialogues.speaker: Nusta
dialogues.text: Great hero, it is an honor to be able to work for you.

choices.text: I feel like we've met before...

response.speaker: Nusta
response.text: That's right! I was fortunate enough to fight against the Abyss alongside you. When the dust settled, we even took a picture together in front of the Stadium of the Sacred Flame!

response.speaker: Nusta
response.text: I never imagined I'd run into you here in Fontaine.

response.speaker: Nusta
response.text: If I'd have known, I wouldn't have tried all those drinks for the first time over at The Rusty Rudder. Standing here in front of you tipsy like this, it's a little bit embarrassing...

response.speaker: Nusta
response.text: Ahem, but don't worry, it's mostly worn off already. I'm in complete control of the situation!

choices.text: How are you finding the work here?

response.speaker: Nusta
response.text: I love it! Working at a film-themed amusement park is the sort of unique life experience you don't often get the chance to enjoy...

response.speaker: Nusta
response.text: If I hadn't gone and made the stupid mistake of drinking and diving — and losing my wallet in the process — then I'm sure I'd be having even more fun!

response.speaker: Nusta
response.text: But even though every last Mora of my travel expenses was in that wallet, it's not the end of the world... You pay decent wages here, so if I work hard enough, I'm sure I'll be able to make it all back in just a few days!

choices.text: Keep up the hard work!

response.speaker: Nusta
response.text: Of course! This adventure attraction is a lot of fun, and there's no better motivation to work hard than doing something that stimulates you!

dialogues.speaker: Brest
dialogues.text: I can't help feeling like it's not fast enough. It would be great if we could modify things to speed up the experience for our guests. Maybe if we installed a void generator on the front and some sort of propulsion device on the back...

choices.text: Are you planning on firing our guests out like cannonballs?

response.speaker: Brest
response.text: Of course! This is supposed to be a thrilling attraction, after all! The faster the ride, the more exciting the experience!

response.speaker: Brest
response.text: That said, what with this being an underwater attraction, you should really be comparing things to torpedoes rather than cannonballs...

response.speaker: Brest
response.text: Obviously, this is an amusement park, so safety is paramount. That's why I want to provide reliable protection for every guest — something along the lines of what the clockwork meka are armored in should do.

response.speaker: Brest
response.text: Not to mention a sufficiently thick and cushioned buffer layer to absorb unforeseen impacts.

response.speaker: Brest
response.text: Hmm... Something seems off about this. In order to meet my design criteria, these suits are going to have to be sturdy enough to knock out a Hunter's Ray...

choices.text: Have you considered the cost?

response.speaker: Brest
response.text: Now that you mention it, the ticket price is quite cheap. If we want to rescale these suits for commercial use, the R&D budget alone...

response.speaker: Brest
response.text: If we can boost the performance parameters for use in law enforcement, we could open the suits up for Maison Gardiennage procurement and cover some of the costs that way.

response.speaker: Brest
response.text: On second thoughts... Covering production costs by selling amusement park equipment to law enforcement agencies... It feels like we've got this all backwards somehow.

choices.text: How about I leave you to figure out the details?

response.speaker: Brest
response.text: Hmm... I'll report back to you when I've reached a conclusion! You're the boss, after all. Your approval is non-negotiable!

dialogues.speaker: Costentin
dialogues.text: Elegant! Exquisite! I'm entirely enamored with these exhilarating improvisations!

choices.text: I do hope you're working hard.

response.speaker: Costentin
response.text: I unquestionably am! I had two double espressos before I started work — my motivation and energy levels are through the roof!

response.speaker: Costentin
response.text: It's just a shame we don't have enough staff to accompany the guests in their puzzle-solving. All we can do is sit by and provide help when necessary. It could be so much more fun...

choices.text: Try not to get overly "enamored." You need to maintain focus.

response.speaker: Costentin
response.text: And I surely will! This attraction may lack the urgency and pressure of battle, but these mechanical challenges are not to be taken lightly!

response.speaker: Costentin
response.text: In the name of the Blade Dancer, I assure you, I will ensure that our guests will be entertained by an experience both exciting and safe!

choices.text: You're really embracing the spirit!

response.speaker: Costentin
response.text: As I eternally do!

dialogues.speaker: Uncle Scimitar
dialogues.text: Well, if it isn't Dehya's friend! So you're my boss this time?

choices.text: I'm looking forward to working with you!

response.speaker: Uncle Scimitar
response.text: You took the words right out of my mouth! However, you should be aware that due to certain personal habits... I might make some small mistakes.

response.speaker: Uncle Scimitar
response.text: Like when playing the villain, I might get a bit too into it and end up scaring the guests... I've been known to comfort children into tears.

response.speaker: Uncle Scimitar
response.text: Please forgive me if something like that ends up happening!

choices.text: I feel like we've met before...

response.speaker: Uncle Scimitar
response.text: Really? Oh, yes!

response.speaker: Uncle Scimitar
response.text: You're famous! And aside from that, you're often out and about. I've seen you quite a few times now, but you probably haven't noticed me before.

response.speaker: Uncle Scimitar
response.text: There was this one time — before I knew you were Dehya's friend — where we even went toe to toe. You gave me a solid beating, as I recall. Perhaps I managed to land a small scratch or two...

response.speaker: Uncle Scimitar
response.text: If so, I must apologize. Anyway, it's all water under the bridge now.

choices.text: Let's get rich together!

response.speaker: Uncle Scimitar
response.text: Alright, I'll work hard to make that happen!

dialogues.speaker: Petit Lumiere
dialogues.text: Wonderful attractions and a wide variety of cinematic themes — it's just like an anthology film! Taking this temp job was absolutely worth it!

choices.text: You're only here on a temporary basis?

response.speaker: Petit Lumiere
response.text: Indeed. As a film director, it's vital to find inspiration in life. Before this, I worked for a while in a shop and even as a blacksmith.

response.speaker: Petit Lumiere
response.text: I may not be able to adjust to certain types of physical labor, but anything to do with the mind is very much in my wheelhouse.

response.speaker: Petit Lumiere
response.text: If you ever need someone to help you come up with ideas, I'm your man!

choices.text: Have you found much inspiration here?

response.speaker: Petit Lumiere
response.text: Indeed, I have. Much to my surprise — and delight — I've been inspired to try out some new shooting techniques.

response.speaker: Petit Lumiere
response.text: In my previous works, I've tended to employ restrained, static shots to drive the narrative. Doing so strikes a good balance between the atmosphere and the information conveyed.

response.speaker: Petit Lumiere
response.text: However, after observing these attractions and considering the broader flow of your guests' movements, I've come up with some new ideas on how to frame my shots.

response.speaker: Petit Lumiere
response.text: I'm going to try them out in my next film. I'm hoping they lead to some interesting new effects.

choices.text: I'll leave you to your observations.

response.speaker: Petit Lumiere
response.text: It's not just about observing. You also need to consider the reasons behind all the fine details.

dialogues.speaker: Ironbelly
dialogues.text: The guests are really getting into it. It's very exciting!

choices.text: Are you wearing a costume?

response.speaker: Ironbelly
response.text: I've been found out. Small wonder you're the boss!

response.speaker: Ironbelly
response.text: I've actually been an extra in quite a few films. One time, I was playing a Fortress of Meropide Guard who took a well-placed knee from a protagonist...

response.speaker: Ironbelly
response.text: My friends and family all said it was my best work — a career highlight! My image has been inextricably tied to this guard costume ever since.

choices.text: I hope we get more reviews like yours.

response.speaker: Ironbelly
response.text: Just look at all the thrilling mechanisms in this attraction! If we could only add a spooky maze, it would be so much more immersive!

response.speaker: Ironbelly
response.text: But it's important to look out for children and those with heart conditions, so I understand why we can't.

response.speaker: Ironbelly
response.text: *sigh* What if I were to open up a separate... "Ghost House" type attraction?

choices.text: Don't get too carried away on the job.

response.speaker: Ironbelly
response.text: Don't worry about me. I won't let myself get careless.

dialogues.speaker: Roxane
dialogues.text: It's rare to get so much time to relax... Life without target practice is so quiet — it feels kind of strange.

choices.text: T—Target practice?

response.speaker: Roxane
response.text: It's part of my job. Don't be nervous.

response.speaker: Roxane
response.text: Training for the Special Security and Surveillance Patrol has recently become more intense. We now have to practice shooting three times a week. Each training session requires firing off 120 rounds, with the 10 worst performers having to run 10 laps around the training ground.

response.speaker: Roxane
response.text: A lot of people say it leaves a buzzing between their ears, but once you get used to it, I think it's exciting. It's like... the metallic clang of a hammer shaping iron. There's something uniquely pleasing about it.

response.speaker: Roxane
response.text: Turenna gave me earplugs to wear, but I never use them.

choices.text: Was your life not quiet before?

response.speaker: Roxane
response.text: I'd say it was very fulfilling!

response.speaker: Roxane
response.text: I plan to become the next exceptional sharpshooter of the Special Security and Surveillance Patrol. I hadn't taken a day off in three months, so Turenna put me on forced leave and sent me out here to relax...

response.speaker: Roxane
response.text: Otherwise, I could still be training right now!

choices.text: It's good to relax, just make sure you don't neglect your work.

response.speaker: Roxane
response.text: You can count on me to complete my mission!

dialogues.speaker: Melies
dialogues.text: If I can get the lighting effects just right on the key mechanisms, then we should be able to get the perfect shot. But we really need to splurge more on props in the future.

choices.text: Splitting your attention between work and inspiration?

response.speaker: Melies
response.text: Haha, my apologies, force of habit... I believe everyone in my profession must suffer from the same affliction.

response.speaker: Melies
response.text: See, I'm here working for you on the side to earn money for shooting my next film. How about... you give me a raise?

response.speaker: Melies
response.text: When production's over, I'll give you top billing in the "With Special Thanks To" section of the credits!

choices.text: You sure your own hard-earned Mora will be enough?

response.speaker: Melies
response.text: I never have enough funds. Balancing the budget is part of a director's responsibilities.

response.speaker: Melies
response.text: Considering the overall requirements of the upcoming picture, I'm inclined to... reduce the outlay on so-called star actors and reallocate those funds to props, set design, and special effects.

response.speaker: Melies
response.text: After all, there's more to a picture than staring at the actors' faces... Exquisite scenery and richly textured props are key elements, too.

choices.text: I can see you have a lot to consider, but don't forget your work either.

response.speaker: Melies
response.text: A skilled director is a master of holding multiple trains of thought. Your attraction's in safe hands, I guarantee!

dialogues.speaker: Jala
dialogues.text: Don't go running off now, little ones. If you're good, we can prepare some delicious food and hold a banquet for you all over at the manor...

choices.text: R—Running off?

response.speaker: Jala
response.text: Don't mind them, they're perfectly harmless — just so long as they don't break anything. It's just a bit of mischief that can be easily trained out of them.

response.speaker: Jala
response.text: But if they start running around and breaking things, or hurting the other animals, even upsetting the local ecosystem...

response.speaker: Jala
response.text: Well, that would make them an invasive species! In which case, they would need to be dealt with... mercilessly!

choices.text: What's on the menu?

response.speaker: Jala
response.text: Uh... I guess it would need to be vegetarian...

response.speaker: Jala
response.text: If they need more protein, then we can add some legumes... Cooking isn't really my forte, my experience is more with looking after prey... We could try taking them back to their natural habitat...

response.speaker: Jala
response.text: Oh, that reminds me. I should really do some research on how to properly feed the guests at the manor.

choices.text: Make sure to look after the animals!

response.speaker: Jala
response.text: It's my duty. I'll see it through to the best of my ability!

dialogues.speaker: Captain Ferment O'Juice
dialogues.text: I've heard that some animals can ferment food in their stomachs to prepare it for eating. If I do the fermenting for them, then it should save them some effort. Genius idea, huh?

choices.text: You'd better have a proper theoretical basis for this...

response.speaker: Captain Ferment O'Juice
response.text: Haha, of course I don't! But a chef's intuition can't possibly be wrong — not when it comes to preparing food.

response.speaker: Captain Ferment O'Juice
response.text: And sure, I've been getting a lot of complaints because the flavor isn't quite right. But if you let fear of criticism stop you from trying new things, then you'll never make any progress.

response.speaker: Captain Ferment O'Juice
response.text: If I get it wrong this time, you can call me every name under the sun. I won't shy away from criticism!

choices.text: Just try not to produce any hazardous chemicals...

response.speaker: Captain Ferment O'Juice
response.text: Of course! I conduct all my experiments in a sealed environment. If they let off any noxious gases, I'll be the first to feel the effects...

response.speaker: Captain Ferment O'Juice
response.text: Once I come to, I'll make sure to destroy the lot. That way, there'll be no risk of wider contamination!

choices.text: You might need to consider the cost...

response.speaker: Captain Ferment O'Juice
response.text: Don't worry about that — when it comes to experiments like this, I pay out of my own pocket!

dialogues.speaker: Hajanad
dialogues.text: Hehe... Haha... Hooheehahahe... Cheer up, my little animals, I've cooked you a delicious treat...

choices.text: Could you try sounding a little less... creepy?

response.speaker: Hajanad
response.text: Oh! I'm sorry, looking after these animals is so therapeutic! It's put me in a wonderful mood... Maybe I got a bit carried away with my laughter.

response.speaker: Hajanad
response.text: I'm a good person, though! I signed a contract and everything. There's no way I would hurt these little cuties!

response.speaker: Hajanad
response.text: Not to mention, as a new researcher, even if I did flee Fontaine, there's no way I could run away from Spantamad. Please believe me!

response.speaker: Hajanad
response.text: *sigh* It's this stupid laugh of mine. If only I could change it...

choices.text: Are you feeling cheerful yourself?

response.speaker: Hajanad
response.text: Of course! It wasn't easy for me to become a researcher, so I decided to take a little holiday to celebrate. Then I ran into this celebration in Fontaine, and so here I am, having fun while making a little extra money on the side...

response.speaker: Hajanad
response.text: I should say, the fact I was able to write a conclusive thesis and officially become a researcher was all due to you.

response.speaker: Hajanad
response.text: If you want, I can agree to only take half my salary as a way to show my gratitude.

choices.text: Be careful what you feed these animals...

response.speaker: Hajanad
response.text: I will! I've committed the safest, most nutritional feed formula to memory. This is a lot simpler than brewing potions, there's no way I can go wrong!

dialogues.speaker: Consigliere's Ex-Left Hand
dialogues.text: As the Demoiselle's partner and esteemed benefactor of the Spina di Rosula, you, too, are my superior. Please, what would you have me do?

choices.text: Just make sure you do a good job.

response.speaker: Consigliere's Ex-Left Hand
response.text: That is a matter of course. I will treat every animal in this manor with the same care and attention as I did when serving Monsieur Consigliere.

response.speaker: Consigliere's Ex-Left Hand
response.text: I merely thought that you might have some additional requirements. For example... That I assist our guests in conversing with the animals, so that they may better understand their viewpoints...

response.speaker: Consigliere's Ex-Left Hand
response.text: Though I may be busy, if you were to have such a requirement, I have... brothers I can call. You wouldn't need to pay another Mora more.

choices.text: What wonderful attire!

response.speaker: Consigliere's Ex-Left Hand
response.text: Why, thank you for the compliment!

response.speaker: Consigliere's Ex-Left Hand
response.text: You have a certain coldness to you, you stand tall and straight — perhaps you, too, might suit... the more solemn attire that we favor in the Spina di Rosula.

response.speaker: Consigliere's Ex-Left Hand
response.text: Were you to dress all in black, with a pair of dark glasses, and conspicuously display your formidable approach throughout the land... I'm sure you could gather your own group of loyal disciples.

choices.text: I'll be going. Stay focused on the job at hand.

response.speaker: Consigliere's Ex-Left Hand
response.text: As you ordain. I won't take up any more of your time!

dialogues.speaker: King of Grilled Fish in Mint Sauce
dialogues.text: Blub!

response.speaker: Observe the Blubberbeast
response.text: (You start to question your reasons for employing a Blubberbeast...)

response.speaker: Observe the Blubberbeast
response.text: (Was it out of curiosity? Or were you trying to show Navia something different?)

response.speaker: Observe the Blubberbeast
response.text: (Whatever the reason... you can't deny that the Blubberbeast is doing a good job. It's probably best to let it get on with its work.)

response.speaker: Observe the Blubberbeast
response.text: (Were it not for the Blubberbeast's consummate professionalism, it seems to you that many of the guests to the Mellow Manor might not have purchased tickets at all...)

response.speaker: Observe the Blubberbeast
response.text: (In fact, based on this performance, you really should be considering giving the Blubberbeast a raise.)

choices.text: ...Blub?

response.speaker: King of Grilled Fish in Mint Sauce
King of Grilled Fish in Mint Sauce
response.text: Blub... blub blub! Blub blub blub! Blub, blub... blub!

response.speaker: Observe the Blubberbeast
response.text: (You casually imitate the Blubberbeast's call, but the creature seems to misunderstand your intent. Believing you to be talking to it in its own language, a wave of excitement washes over the Blubberbeast...)

response.speaker: Observe the Blubberbeast
response.text: (Despite its most enthusiastic salutations, you are unable to comprehend its meaning...)

response.speaker: Observe the Blubberbeast
response.text: (You find yourself seriously considering hiring an animal whisperer to teach you how to communicate with certain animals...)

choices.text: Good Blubberbeast! After work, I'll reward you with a grilled fish!

response.speaker: King of Grilled Fish in Mint Sauce
response.text: Blub blub!

dialogues.speaker: Basima the Fifth
dialogues.text: I'm not saying everyone else isn't cute, but finches are definitely the cutest!

choices.text: Who's the second cutest?

response.speaker: Basima the Fifth
response.text: Oh, that's not something I've given much thought to...

response.speaker: Basima the Fifth
response.text: Squirrels are fluffy, fungi are springy...

response.speaker: Basima the Fifth
response.text: Then there's slimes, they're all pudgy and soft and adorably slow — not that I've stroked one.

response.speaker: Basima the Fifth
response.text: If I had to give my appraisal, I'd say... I really can't decide!

choices.text: The same goes for your mindset!

response.speaker: Basima the Fifth
response.text: Huh! Are you saying my mindset is "cute"? Thank you for the compliment...

response.speaker: Basima the Fifth
response.text: If you hadn't mentioned it, I wouldn't have thought there was anything special about my mindset. I'm used to it, after all...

response.speaker: Basima the Fifth
response.text: In that case, I'm going to work extra hard to try and spread my mindset to as many guests as I can...

response.speaker: Basima the Fifth
response.text: Then the whole world can be cute together!

choices.text: That's the spirit! Make sure to enjoy your work!

response.speaker: Basima the Fifth
response.text: Hehe, thank you for giving me the opportunity. This job is so great! The next time you need someone, let me know.

dialogues.speaker: Ororon
dialogues.text: I've realized we're in a bit of a tricky situation here.

dialogues.speaker: Ifa
dialogues.text: What do you mean?

dialogues.speaker: Ororon
dialogues.text: If we go out, we won't have time to watch that film we rented.

dialogues.speaker: Ifa
dialogues.text: But if we stay in and watch the film, we won't have time to go out.

dialogues.speaker: Ororon
dialogues.text: Oh, you realized it too?

dialogues.speaker: Ifa
dialogues.text: Yeah, well... pretty smart for a five-year-old.

dialogues.speaker: Ajaw
dialogues.text: It's all your fault! All your fault! Your fault, your fault, your fault!

dialogues.speaker: Kinich
dialogues.text: Stop yelling and get to the point.

dialogues.speaker: Ajaw
dialogues.text: If you hadn't kept me locked away, I could have asked that judge to step in for me!

dialogues.speaker: Ajaw
dialogues.text: He'd have backed me up for sure, and then we'd have kicked your sorry little butt!

dialogues.speaker: Kinich
dialogues.text: For real, now? Did you even hear yourself?

dialogues.speaker: Kinich
dialogues.text: You'd better focus on outsmarting Cacucu first.

dialogues.speaker: Wriothesley
dialogues.text: I know you mentioned a while back that people from Natlan would soon start showing up all over the world, but I hadn't expected anything like this.

dialogues.speaker: Neuvillette
dialogues.text: It seems no matter where they come from, all dragons are inquisitive by nature...

dialogues.speaker: Cacucu
dialogues.text: You can say that again, bro!

dialogues.speaker: Neuvillette
dialogues.text: The same might well be said for humankind.

dialogues.speaker: Neuvillette
dialogues.text: The real reason you chose to stay to investigate this case was your curiosity about Natlan and Mr. Cacucu, was it not?

dialogues.speaker: Wriothesley
dialogues.text: Haha, guilty as charged. Nothing gets past you.

dialogues.speaker: Wriothesley
dialogues.text: So, how about we take this opportunity to chat a little more? We've got the world's best translator on hand, after all.

dialogues.speaker: Cacucu
dialogues.text: Sure thing, bro!

dialogues.speaker: Ifa
dialogues.text: In a good mood, I see?

dialogues.speaker: Ororon
dialogues.text: Yep! Seeing my dear vegetables all settled in right where they belong brings me great joy.

dialogues.speaker: Ifa
dialogues.text: You sound like a proud parent. I'm happy for you, bro.

dialogues.speaker: Ifa
dialogues.text: But given how "where they belong" is inside a cooking pot... that kind of fills me with dread at the same time.

dialogues.speaker: Cacucu
dialogues.text: Nice to meet you, bro!

dialogues.speaker: Ifa
dialogues.text: The heck are you on about? Does this really seem like a good time for "nice to meet you"?

dialogues.speaker: Ororon
dialogues.text: I guess he's referring to the "meeting" of the vegetables and the pot.

dialogues.speaker: Cacucu
dialogues.text: You got it, bro!

dialogues.speaker: Ifa
dialogues.text: Honestly, right now, I'm not sure if I should be worrying about your definition of "nice to meet you," or investigating whether you and Cacucu share some kind of telepathic bond...

dialogues.speaker: Kinich
dialogues.text: Come on, just spit it out. I can tell you're itching to say something.

dialogues.speaker: Ajaw
dialogues.text: Ahahaha! Kinich, you big dummy, you fell for it, huh?

dialogues.speaker: Ajaw
dialogues.text: Nooo, what's wrong, feeling lonely without the Almighty Dragonlord to talk to?

dialogues.speaker: Ajaw
dialogues.text: If a bedtime story's what you're after, just say so! I'll tell you one so bone-chilling you won't be able to sleep for three nights straight!

dialogues.speaker: Kinich
dialogues.text: Sure, go ahead.

dialogues.speaker: Ajaw
dialogues.text: Huh? What do you mean "go ahead"? You pretending to be a tough guy, now?

dialogues.speaker: Kinich
dialogues.text: Maybe, maybe not. But one thing's for sure — if I don't sleep, neither do you.

dialogues.speaker: Wriothesley
dialogues.text: On the topic of kidnapping cases...

dialogues.speaker: Neuvillette
dialogues.text: Hm?

dialogues.speaker: Wriothesley
dialogues.text: How exactly do we define the subject of a kidnapping? According to the regulations, I mean.

dialogues.speaker: Wriothesley
dialogues.text: Aside from humans, do pets count? What about sentient non-human beings?

dialogues.speaker: Wriothesley
dialogues.text: Of course, Melusines go without saying, but what about a being like Cacucu?

dialogues.speaker: Neuvillette
dialogues.text: I am surprised that you're unfamiliar with the legal provisions on this matter.

dialogues.speaker: Wriothesley
dialogues.text: Haha, if I knew all the laws like the back of my hand, I wouldn't have ended up in the Fortress of Meropide, would I?

dialogues.speaker: Neuvillette
dialogues.text: ...That is no laughing matter, Wriothesley.

dialogues.speaker: Ororon
dialogues.text: Earlier on, that lady with the pink hair took a picture of Ajaw and Cacucu together.

dialogues.speaker: Ifa
dialogues.text: You sound a little disappointed. Were you hoping to be in it too?

dialogues.speaker: Ororon
dialogues.text: I was, at first.

dialogues.speaker: Ororon
dialogues.text: But after seeing how awkward Ajaw looked, I figured I wouldn't really fit in.

dialogues.speaker: Ajaw
dialogues.text: Huh!? And you didn't think of sharing this any sooner!?

dialogues.speaker: Ajaw
dialogues.text: I'd have cuddled your neck and smiled for the Kamera! Anything to get out of being in the same frame as that thing!

dialogues.speaker: Ororon
dialogues.text: Really? Well no worries, you still can. Come here, give us a hug!

dialogues.speaker: Ajaw
dialogues.text: I hope your face is ready, 'cause it's about to get flame-roasted!

dialogues.speaker: Cacucu
dialogues.text: I got your back, bro!

dialogues.speaker: Ifa
dialogues.text: Kinich, have you thought about maybe... ditching that little rascal? Leaving him here for good when you leave?

dialogues.speaker: Kinich
dialogues.text: I have. But given that Ajaw's also an old relic, that would probably count as international smuggling.

dialogues.speaker: Kinich
dialogues.text: I can't bring myself to knowingly break the law.

dialogues.speaker: Ifa
dialogues.text: Haha, guess we all have our problems in life.

dialogues.speaker: Chevreuse
dialogues.text: We're currently questioning the suspect connected to gray-market gambling operations. We'll keep you all posted as soon as we have any new information.

dialogues.speaker: Neuvillette
dialogues.text: Your efforts are much appreciated.

dialogues.speaker: Wriothesley
dialogues.text: Sounds like I'm no longer needed here. Guess I'll be on my way...

dialogues.speaker: Neuvillette
dialogues.text: One moment.

dialogues.speaker: Neuvillette
dialogues.text: As a key witness, you may be called upon to attend the follow-up trial, Mr. Wriothesley.

dialogues.speaker: Wriothesley
dialogues.text: Oh no... For real, bro?

dialogues.speaker: Wriothesley
dialogues.text: Sorry, I meant... Could I maybe attend anonymously?

dialogues.speaker: Chevreuse
dialogues.text: Uh... How exactly would that work? Do you even hear yourself?

dialogues.speaker: Sigewinne
dialogues.text: #Hey there, {NICKNAME}, Paimon!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hey, Sigewinne! Welcome to the Chevalmarin Film Fantasyland!

choices.text: You sure have your finger on the pulse!

response.speaker: Sigewinne
response.text: Actually, both! Navia told me about the plans at the Beauty Association's last meet-up, so I've been looking forward to it since.

response.speaker: Sigewinne
response.text: But it's become so popular now that everyone's talking about it, even down in the Fortress of Meropide! Many of our staff members are actually hoping to take time off to visit.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Aw, your encouragement leaves Paimon feeling even more motivated than ever!

choices.text: What kind of films are you into, Sigewinne?

response.speaker: Sigewinne
response.text: Oh, well... I guess I prefer animated films! You know, the light-hearted and fun type.

response.speaker: Sigewinne
response.text: For example, there's a group of creators who come up with these magical stories about cute little animals. I've watched every last one of their films!

response.speaker: Sigewinne
response.text: Funnily enough, it just so happens that according to our new regulations, well-behaved inmates are now allowed to spend their Credit Coupons on watching films up to three times a week.

response.speaker: Sigewinne
response.text: I run the projector in my free time since we don't have a dedicated staff member yet.

response.speaker: Sigewinne
response.text: So, I decided to show them films like My Neighbor Kokoro.

response.speaker: Sigewinne
response.text: I also started showing them a famous series called Dom and Cherry. It's super long, with hundreds of episodes, but it never gets old.

choices.text: A bunch of hardened criminals watching films about cute little animals...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: But now they've got films to watch, even the ones who used to cause trouble might settle down a bit, right?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: We have our very own animal-themed area, by the way. We call it "Mellow Manor." Customers are calling it the most relaxing place in the park!

response.speaker: Sigewinne
response.text: Ooh, ooh, I've been there already! I wasn't expecting it to be so fun!

response.speaker: Sigewinne
response.text: There were all kinds of animals living together, ones I'd never even imagined. It almost felt like I'd stepped into the film Zoo-Opolis!

choices.text: If you've got the time, why don't you come back every day?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Oh, you mean we could invite Sigewinne to be a consultant at Mellow Manor?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Now that you mention it, that sounds like a great idea! Sigewinne's great at caring for people, and she's so warm and gentle. Looking after animals should be a piece of cake!

response.speaker: Sigewinne
response.text: A... consultant?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Yeah! Like someone who gives advice and tells the park staff how to do their jobs better!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: The workload won't be too heavy, but it's important work. Besides, you'll mostly be playing with the animals!

response.speaker: Sigewinne
response.text: That sounds like a lot of fun! Sign me up!

response.speaker: Sigewinne
response.text: As it happens, things aren't that busy in the Fortress right now. Had I known you were recruiting for this position earlier, I might've even applied myself!

response.speaker: Sigewinne
response.text: But before I start, I'll have to make arrangements for the medical team in my absence, borrow some related books from my doctor friends, and — last but not least — prepare gifts for the animals!

response.speaker: Sigewinne
response.text: If it's not too inconvenient for you, why don't we meet up again at Marcotte Station sometime soon?

choices.text: No inconvenience at all!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hehe, with Sigewinne on board, Mellow Manor's gonna be even better than before. Paimon has a feeling our revenue's gonna shoot through the roof!

choices.text: It's settled, then!
Wanna enjoy yourself there and earn some Mora on the side?
I'm finding it quite hard to imagine.
I'm curious what your favorite genres are...
Or has the park really become that famous?

dialogues.speaker: Sigewinne
dialogues.text: You're here!

dialogues.speaker: Sigewinne
dialogues.text: I've prepared two boxes of books about animals. We should be able to find the solution to any health issues they might have right away!

choices.text: So well prepared!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Forget health issues — Paimon wouldn't be surprised if she could actually chat with the animals once she's done reading...

response.speaker: Giustina
response.text: Wait, Head Nurse, please don't go! Whew, boy am I glad I caught up with you!

response.speaker: Giustina
response.text: One of the inmates has become obsessed with those "Magical Mouse Munchies" from the animated films you've been showing them — and tried making some himself with three days' worth of Welfare Meals...

response.speaker: Giustina
response.text: He ended up giving himself food poisoning, with symptoms we've never even seen before! Please, we need your help!

response.speaker: Sigewinne
response.text: Eh? We warned them not to take those films too seriously...

response.speaker: Sigewinne
response.text: But if you've chased me all this way, things must be pretty serious!

response.speaker: Sigewinne
response.text: I'm really sorry... I'll have to ask you to help me take my luggage to the amusement park for now.

response.speaker: Sigewinne
response.text: Before you arrived, I was thinking through some emergencies that might occur with the animals. I even started putting some suggestions together.

response.speaker: Sigewinne
response.text: You can give them to the staff at the Mellow Manor in advance. They should come in handy soon!

choices.text: No rush, we'll be waiting for you!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Sigewinne sure has it tough! Not only does she have to worry about taking care of her patients, she also has to clean up after those troublemakers...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Why don't we prepare something tasty for her? It might help lift her spirits!

choices.text: Your patients' health is the top priority!
That's reassuring!

dialogues.speaker: Sigewinne
dialogues.text: Phew, problem solved, at last...

dialogues.speaker: Sigewinne
dialogues.text: #Sorry about that, {NICKNAME} and Paimon. The patient's condition was a bit tricky, so it took a while to deal with.

choices.text: You must be exhausted. Here, have a drink.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: And here's a special snack, too. Hope it gets your strength back up!

response.speaker: Sigewinne
response.text: Oh wow, thank you!

response.speaker: Sigewinne
response.text: To be honest, though, things like this don't really tire me out. It's more that I just can't wrap my head around it.

response.speaker: Sigewinne
response.text: At the start of every children's film, they clearly state: "All events and products in this film are purely fictional. Please do not try to imitate them." And yet, fully-grown adults end up doing just that...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Is it because they aren't paying any attention when they're watching? Or is it some rebellious mentality — a "whatever you tell me not to do, I'll do it just to prove you wrong" type of thing?

choices.text: Not much we can do if they don't read the warnings at all.

response.speaker: Sigewinne
response.text: Hmm, maybe this is starting to get a bit too deep...

response.speaker: Sigewinne
response.text: If I get a chance, I'll speak to His Grace and Monsieur Neuvillette to see if we can think of a way to prevent such issues.

response.speaker: Sigewinne
response.text: For now, let's focus on Mellow Manor instead. I might be late, but I'm here now!

choices.text: But deliberately ignoring them... That's another thing altogether.
We made you some fruit tea.

dialogues.speaker: Sigewinne
dialogues.text: Come on, little cuties, time for some yummy in those tummies!

dialogues.speaker: Sigewinne
dialogues.text: You're all such sweethearts, aren't you? Happy, healthy, and getting on like best of friends!

dialogues.speaker: Varesa
dialogues.text: #Whoa, is that... Our hero, {NICKNAME}? And Paimon too!

dialogues.speaker: Varesa
dialogues.text: Oh, I guess I shouldn't be too surprised. Miss Escoffier already told me you were the big boss here...

dialogues.speaker: Varesa
dialogues.text: But when I saw you just now, I forgot myself for a moment...

choices.text: Me, the big boss? For real, now?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Technically speaking, the Chevalmarin Film Fantasyland doesn't even have a boss, does it?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Isn't the idea that everyone works together to make it as successful as possible, and then we all share the profits?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: But wait a sec... Why are you here, Varesa?

response.speaker: Varesa
response.text: Mm... Well, officially, I'm here to promote my brand!

response.speaker: Varesa
response.text: Not long ago, Miss Escoffier placed an order with me for her restaurant, as she often does.

response.speaker: Varesa
response.text: In her letter, she mentioned that showcasing my orchard's products at the festival would boost sales and help build my brand recognition, hehe!

response.speaker: Varesa
response.text: After talking it through with my parents, I decided to give it a shot.

response.speaker: Varesa
response.text: Now that I'm done with the restaurant's ingredient order, I plan to sell the rest of my fruit directly to guests — to help quench their thirst, of course!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: The thought of enjoying fresh fruit from Natlan here in Fontaine does sound pretty appealing...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: But with this many customers, wouldn't it be exhausting to watch the stall all day?

response.speaker: Varesa
response.text: Huh? Am I supposed to be watching the stall the whole time...?

response.speaker: Varesa
response.text: There's an attraction over there called Movie Masterpieces, right? I heard some of the challenges are based on famous films.

response.speaker: Varesa
response.text: Some of those films have even been adapted into great comics. I'd love to go give it a try!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: So you're not doing any business at all?

response.speaker: Varesa
response.text: Back in the Collective of Plenty, I'd just set up a sign with the fruit prices, place a weighing scale and a coin jar to one side, then let people pay on their own...

response.speaker: Varesa
response.text: When closing time came around, I'd wake up and check the accounts — not a single Mora's ever gone missing!

response.speaker: Player
response.text: You've got a lot of trust in people!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: To be fair, that does sound nice! People in the Collective of Plenty are a law-abiding bunch. No one would even think about taking something without paying... Makes sense that tending your stall wouldn't take too much effort.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Fontainian customers are no doubt trustworthy too, but... Let's just say they're not used to "self-service shopping"!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Plus, if you just leave the stall unattended as a Natlanese merchant, people here might think you're gone for good!

response.speaker: Varesa
response.text: In that case, I'd better start acting the part!

response.speaker: Varesa
response.text: But I'll need to buy some things in the city before I officially open for business...

response.speaker: Varesa
response.text: I promised to bring back some Fontainian clockwork meka for Coach Iansan.

response.speaker: Varesa
response.text: Oh, and I also wanted to try a few rounds of Movie Masterpieces. After that, I should be able to focus on my business without getting distracted!

choices.text: We'll go with you.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Mm-hmm! We might not be locals, but we've explored Fontaine quite a bit. We know our way around pretty well!

response.speaker: Varesa
response.text: In that case, give me a moment to get some extra fruit, a price list, and my coin jar set up!

response.speaker: Varesa
response.text: #Hehe, I get to go shopping with {NICKNAME}! Nice!

choices.text: We're a talented pair of shoppers.
I'm just an operations staff member.

dialogues.speaker: Varesa
dialogues.text: Hello, boss! I'm from the Collective of Plenty. You might recall receiving a letter from us requesting you to design some components...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Wait a sec, why does Iansan need clockwork meka?

choices.text: Is she planning to build some kind of robotic personal trainer...

response.speaker: Varesa
response.text: Nothing like that! Our coach just wants to fine-tune her gym equipment so people can target different muscle groups more easily.

response.speaker: Varesa
response.text: She mentioned something about a "rowing machine" to focus on back muscles, as well as a "pec deck" and a "leg press machine"...

response.speaker: Varesa
response.text: The parts that connect the ropes and weight plates wear out easily, but they need to be strong, so Coach Iansan thought she'd give Fontainian clockwork meka a try.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: It all sounds so technical! When did fitness turn into some kind of complex engineering problem?

response.speaker: Varesa
response.text: Hehe, to be honest, I don't really get all the details either. But if it works out, I'll be sure to train according to her revised method!

response.speaker: Varesa
response.text: And if it doesn't... we can always stick to the good old methods!

response.speaker: Varesa
response.text: If you're interested, I can show you a few beginner exercises the next time you drop by our tribe!

response.speaker: Varesa
response.text: You'll be able to smash the records without even breaking a sweat, I know it!

choices.text: Sure thing. Time to flex those guns!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Uh... Paimon'll pass on that one... She'll be rooting for you from the sidelines, though!

response.speaker: Varesa
response.text: You can always try the equipment we keep for little saurians, Paimon! As long as you start out with the super light weights, you'll be fine!

response.speaker: Varesa
response.text: Weight training's for everyone, y'know! As long as you put in the effort and keep at it, anyone can develop rock-solid muscles!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Eh, no...

response.speaker: Black Screen
response.text: You spend some time chatting about fitness with Varesa while strolling around the Quartier Lyonnais, then agree to regroup at the Chevalmarin Film Fantasyland later on...

choices.text: Not necessarily. I tend to rely more on technique!
To whip lazy trainees into shape?

dialogues.speaker: Varesa
dialogues.text: Alright, time to show off how fast I can run! I'm gonna go have a blast, then come back, calm down, and focus on running my fruit stall.

choices.text: Don't forget to grab some water.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: That's right. Last thing you'd want is to get too absorbed in having fun, then suddenly realize you're starving 'cause you haven't eaten anything for hours...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Funnily enough, Paimon can think of someone else with a bad habit of getting so into things that they forget to eat... No matter how busy you are, nothing's more important than staying well-fed, hydrated, and healthy!

choices.text: Wow, so you know someone like that too, huh?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hmph!

response.speaker: Varesa
response.text: No need to worry about me, guys! I do a lot of long-distance running, so I always make sure to bring some food and water with me. This time is no exception!

response.speaker: Black Screen
response.text: Varesa steps into the Movie Masterpieces play zone and dives right in...

response.speaker: Varesa
response.text: Woohoo, that was incredible!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: How was it? Did you get through all the levels?

response.speaker: Varesa
response.text: It... was... amazing! Not only did I get a super high score, but I also checked up on every homage to the original films, and even recreated several iconic scenes starring comic book superheroes!

response.speaker: Varesa
response.text: I'll focus on doing business this time round, but if there's ever another event like this, please let me know as early as possible. I want in!

choices.text: It's a deal, superhero specialissimo!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Yep! Y'know what, we should let you design the levels. Paimon's sure all the fans will be thrilled!

response.speaker: Varesa
response.text: That would be great! Anyway, back to business — time to focus on my fruit stall. I'm gonna make a name for my orchard in Fontaine.

choices.text: We'll let you know, for sure!
Ooh, I wonder who that is? They need to fix that habit, that's for sure!
And snacks to keep your energy up.

dialogues.speaker: Varesa
dialogues.text: Seeing how happy everyone is here, I can't help smiling myself... Hehe...

dialogues.speaker: Varesa
dialogues.text: Would you like some fruit? Feel free to take some!

dialogues.speaker: Dehya
dialogues.text: #Hey, {NICKNAME}, Paimon!

dialogues.speaker: Dehya
dialogues.text: What a coincidence, running into you guys here!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Dehya? Paimon didn't expect to see you here either!

choices.text: Here to see the sights?

response.speaker: Dehya
response.text: Haha, as it turns out, both!

response.speaker: Dehya
response.text: A while back, myself and some other members of the Blazing Beasts were invited over to star in an adventure film here in Fontaine.

response.speaker: Dehya
response.text: The film was pretty well-received, so as soon as the director heard about this event, we were invited here as guests.

response.speaker: Dehya
response.text: To satisfy the audience, the director took pains to recreate sets from the film...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Guess that's not scenery most Fontainians see every day, huh...

choices.text: Did you appear in the film, Dehya?

response.speaker: Dehya
response.text: Me? Ahaha... Unfortunately, I got a little too into one of the action scenes, accidentally wrecked half the set, and got the boot. I ended up just doing odd jobs instead...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Wait, aren't fight scenes supposed to be as realistic as possible...? Surely the more punches that land, the better?

response.speaker: Dehya
response.text: Well, the production team didn't have much of a budget, so if they'd shot a few more takes and the set collapsed again, they would've gone bust.

response.speaker: Dehya
response.text: Plus, even the toughest fighter we had in the crew, Uncle Scimitar, couldn't last more than a few moves against me!

choices.text: And what was his role in the film?

response.speaker: Dehya
response.text: Actually, no. He was playing one of the key villains, and was supposed to perform a grand sword dance in front of the protagonist. If things had gone how they were meant to, it would have been an amazing fight scene.

response.speaker: Dehya
response.text: But the lead actor, exhausted from working all day, was so hungry and in a rush to wrap the scene that he improvised and pretended to shoot him with a gun instead.

response.speaker: Dehya
response.text: After thinking it over, the director decided to keep the scene — and to our surprise, the audience loved it. It even turned Uncle Scimitar into a bit of a star!

choices.text: Heh, thought I'd seen that guy somewhere before...

response.speaker: Dehya
response.text: In a little while, he's gonna be very busy signing autographs for fans — something I should really be helping out with, actually.

response.speaker: Dehya
response.text: But now that I've run into you guys, how about this... I go give them a heads up, get them to cover for me, and then we go out for a drink or two?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Eh? You sure that's okay?

response.speaker: Dehya
response.text: Hey, we're old friends, so why not? Running into you and Paimon here in a foreign land is the best surprise I've had today!

response.speaker: Dehya
response.text: I heard about a bar called The Rusty Rudder along the coast to the southeast. I'll see you there!

choices.text: Pretty sure I've done something similar before myself...
Hopefully not just to get pummeled into submission by you...?
I'd love to see the scenes you starred in...
Or are you on the job?

dialogues.speaker: Dehya
dialogues.text: Here you are!

dialogues.speaker: Dehya
dialogues.text: I took the liberty of ordering you a "Misty Sunrise." It's basically Bulle Fruit juice, but flavored with Romaritime Flower and Nilotpala Lotus extracts.

dialogues.speaker: Dehya
dialogues.text: For Paimon, I picked "Cloudtop Slumber" — a special blend of Milk and Single-Origin Yauwan Tea, topped with whipped cream and sugar.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: They both sound delicious!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: But how come you seem so familiar with this bar when it's your first time here? Paimon's never even heard of the drinks you ordered us!

choices.text: We wouldn't even know where to start.

response.speaker: Dehya
response.text: Hah, all part of the job. Bein' a merc means adapting to new environments. You get used to dealing with the unknown.

response.speaker: Dehya
response.text: Taverns in different parts of Teyvat all have unique customs, sure, but you pick up some tricks when it comes to chatting up bartenders.

response.speaker: Dehya
response.text: Honestly, having a stable job might bring you a sense of structure and security, but it sure gets boring over time.

response.speaker: Dehya
response.text: Never a dull moment when I'm with you guys, though! There's always something unexpected to keep me on my toes.

choices.text: Pff, I like to think we're pretty down to earth!

response.speaker: Dehya
response.text: Anything exciting lately? I'm all ears.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hmm, where to begin... Literally everything that's happened has been pretty incredible, if you think about it...

response.speaker: Black Screen
response.text: You tell Dehya about your recent experiences...

response.speaker: Dehya
response.text: Whew, the jobs you've taken on are no joke. If a merc was to price them, any one would be worth what some merchants make in six months.

response.speaker: Dehya
response.text: Which reminds me — have you ever thought about part-timing as a hired sword?

response.speaker: Dehya
response.text: Every now and then, the Blazing Beasts receive commissions from some really far-flung places. If you guys were on board, we wouldn't need to cut deals with outsiders.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Huh? So we could become mercs too?

choices.text: It sure sounds like a pretty cool title.

response.speaker: Dehya
response.text: Well, who says you can't be both? You're also an Honorary Knight of Mondstadt, right? As far as I see it, every new title is a new opportunity — a foot in the door wherever you go.

response.speaker: Dehya
response.text: Besides, with your skills, who'd dare to push tasks on you? If it suits you, take it. If not, just turn it down. You'd be the ones calling the shots.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: That actually makes a lot of sense... When you think about it, it's not all that different from adventure commissions.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Who knows, maybe we'll find jobs where we can help a lot of people while also bringing in a nice chunk of Mora! Wouldn't hurt to build connections with Dehya's Eremite friends either, would it?

choices.text: Sure, we can try it out.

response.speaker: Dehya
response.text: Awesome! In that case, I'll have a word with my guys and gals when I get back. I'll try to get you first dibs on the best and most lucrative jobs!

response.speaker: Dehya
response.text: We'll need to figure out which areas we'll be assigning you commissions for... But I'll talk that over with the others.

response.speaker: Black Screen
response.text: You have fun chatting with Dehya while enjoying your drinks. Before parting ways, you agree to meet up again at the Chevalmarin Film Fantasyland sometime soon...

choices.text: Partners of the Blazing Beasts... I like the sound of it!
But I'm already an adventurer!
Yeah... We've seen some really wild stuff.
We'd never have thought of ordering drinks like these.

dialogues.speaker: Dehya
dialogues.text: #{NICKNAME} and Paimon, good news!

dialogues.speaker: Dehya
dialogues.text: I spoke to my crew. All Blazing Beasts are fully all on board with the idea.

dialogues.speaker: Dehya
dialogues.text: Any commissions we receive for the region west of the Hypostyle Desert, north of the Desert of Hadramaveth, east of Ardravi Valley, and south of the Ashavan Realm are yours!

dialogues.speaker: Dehya
dialogues.text: We haven't had many lately, but in the past, we've usually gotten a few good ones every year.

dialogues.speaker: Dehya
dialogues.text: The pay's insane, but so are the risks. The type of work that normally calls for a team of heavily armed mercs.

dialogues.speaker: Dehya
dialogues.text: But this should be just right for you. If it were any easier, you might not even break a sweat!

choices.text: Sounds perfect!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: You're so quick, Dehya! Everyone agreed, just like that. Guess that means we're now official partners of the Blazing Beasts...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hooah! Watch out world, there's a couple of new mercs on the scene! ...Maybe Paimon should give herself a proper mercenary name?

response.speaker: Dehya
response.text: Haha, and when you're working in other nations, don't forget to give the Blazing Beasts a little plug now and then:

response.speaker: Dehya
response.text: "We Protect, You Prosper!"

response.speaker: Dehya
response.text: Anyway, I'll send a letter to the Adventurers' Guild in various places when a job comes up. Make sure you check your mail!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: It's a deal!

choices.text: Such clear-cut profit regions, too.

dialogues.speaker: Dehya
dialogues.text: You know what? I haven't felt this relaxed in quite a while.

dialogues.speaker: Dehya
dialogues.text: The humid air here is a nice change, and combined with the warm weather... *yawn* I'm actually getting kinda sleepy.

dialogues.speaker: Lynette
dialogues.text: Mmm... Detecting the arrival of my two most esteemed friends. Activating chat mode...

dialogues.speaker: Lynette
dialogues.text: #Hello, {NICKNAME} and Paimon.

choices.text: Hello, Lynette!

response.speaker: Lynette
response.text: Yes. A director we know invited us to come here and "unwind." Just as well. It's an opportunity to recharge.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: "Us"...? Wait, but Paimon hasn't seen Lyney anywhere!

response.speaker: Lynette
response.text: Well... That's his own fault.

response.speaker: Lynette
response.text: We've been working with this director a lot lately, so my brother took it upon himself to familiarize himself with their style... And ended up watching all of their films.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: All of them? That's some serious dedication right there...

response.speaker: Lynette
response.text: The issue is, this director is famous for psychological horror films.

response.speaker: Lynette
response.text: Lyney got so into the plot twists that he didn't sleep properly for three days straight and ended up completely messing up his sleep cycle.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Paimon had no idea Lyney was so into horror films!

response.speaker: Lynette
response.text: He tends to get very absorbed in his magic shows, so he probably finds it easy to relate to the characters.

response.speaker: Lynette
response.text: The way the director uses psychological suggestion is quite similar to how we use it in our shows, after all.

response.speaker: Lynette
response.text: My brother's still over at the actors' residence. If I had to guess, he's either catching up on sleep or analyzing those films...

response.speaker: Lynette
response.text: So that's why I'm out here recharging by myself.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Well that's a side of Lyney we've never seen before...

choices.text: Now I'm curious about these plot twists myself...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Don't even think about roping Paimon into this!

response.speaker: Lynette
response.text: Me neither. I don't like jump scares or stories that give you the chills afterward.

response.speaker: Lynette
response.text: Shouldn't films be relaxing? Something with beautiful visuals, or at least a simple plot that doesn't require too much thinking?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hmm... Sounds like Eclectic Escapades would be more to your liking, then. Wanna give it a try?

response.speaker: Lynette
response.text: Thank you, I've actually done so already. I really liked it.

response.speaker: Lynette
response.text: But maybe watching others would be even more entertaining...

choices.text: I get you...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Uh, is that really that entertaining...?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Still, if you're interested in the attraction, why not become a consultant? That way, you'd get to see more of the visitors' reactions, too!

response.speaker: Lynette
response.text: That... doesn't sound like a bad idea. And as it happens, I do have a few days off before filming starts.

response.speaker: Lynette
response.text: But first, I need to help Lyney pull himself together...

response.speaker: Lynette
response.text: I noticed an attraction nearby called "Mellow Manor" that looks really relaxing. Sounds like just what my brother needs to take his mind off those horror films...

response.speaker: Lynette
response.text: Plus, some magic tricks require animal assistants, so it'll be a chance for me to learn more about their habits.

choices.text: Seeing as we're the hosts...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Great idea! If we can get Lyney on board, the Chevalmarin Film Fantasyland will be even more popular than it already is!

choices.text: Why don't we go invite Lyney in person later on?
That priceless look on people's faces as they plummet...
Which scenes is Lyney focusing on in particular?
Were you invited as a special guest too?

dialogues.speaker: Lynette
dialogues.text: Lyney, I'm back.

dialogues.speaker: Lynette
dialogues.text: The Chevalmarin Film Fantasyland is so much fun, and there are loads of cute little animals. Come on, take a break from those horror films already.

dialogues.speaker: Lyney
dialogues.text: *yawn* I'm delighted to hear that you've been enjoying yourself, but I need to concentrate on this film for now. Those animal assistants will have to wait...

dialogues.speaker: Lyney
dialogues.text: I just need a little... more sleep...

dialogues.speaker: Lyney
dialogues.text: Ugh... Every time I close my eyes, I keep thinking of new tricks. So tired... Can't sleep, but can't get up either...

choices.text: Then why don't you come out and have a walk?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: That's right, Lyney! A change of pace should stop your mind from wandering!

response.speaker: Lyney
response.text: #Wait, {NICKNAME}, Paimon, you two are here as well!?

response.speaker: Lynette
response.text: They're the managers of the park, and I'm about to become a consultant for one of the attractions too.

response.speaker: Lyney
response.text: In that case, count me in! Not just for my own sake, of course, but to support my friends!

response.speaker: Lyney
response.text: Just give me a moment to freshen up...

response.speaker: Lynette
response.text: #If there's one person Lyney can't say no to, it's you, {NICKNAME}. You're in a league all of your own.

choices.text: That goes without saying!

response.speaker: Lynette
response.text: I'm not exactly sure how long my brother meant by "a moment"... So why don't we meet back up at the venue?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Sounds good! Getting Lyney to cheer up and visit the amusement park's surely our greatest success yet!

choices.text: That's my style!
There'll be cute animals to play with...

dialogues.speaker: Lyney
dialogues.text: Thanks for inviting me to come down, you two!

dialogues.speaker: Lyney
dialogues.text: I must say, I feel like a new man after visiting the park and seeing all those adorable animals.

dialogues.speaker: Lyney
dialogues.text: Seems like Lynette has her eye on some great potential animal assistants, too...

dialogues.speaker: Lynette
dialogues.text: Freminet often works with Blubberbeasts anyway, so I think they'd make a great fit.

dialogues.speaker: Lynette
dialogues.text: "Father" has spoken of how obedient and well-behaved squirrels are, so they're a great choice too.

dialogues.speaker: Lyney
dialogues.text: Oh, and did you see those weird mushrooms? Can we take home a few of those as well?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: That... might not be possible! These Fungi have been specially trained, y'know. They're like... the stunt actors of the elemental world.

choices.text: If you're after soft and squishy, there are other options.

response.speaker: Lynette
response.text: Okay then, I'll wait for you to bring us a little kitty.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: ...Um, are you sure about that? Paimon's pretty sure we've never seen a cat anywhere near as big and as soft as a Fungus...

choices.text: A nice fluffy cat would fit the bill, too.

dialogues.speaker: Lynette
dialogues.text: The expressions on the guests' faces as they zoomed around were... priceless.

dialogues.speaker: Lynette
dialogues.text: I hope we can inspire similar reactions in our future audiences, too.

dialogues.speaker: Lyney
dialogues.text: Ahh, I feel so much better after seeing those animals. They're all so... carefree.

dialogues.speaker: Lyney
dialogues.text: The other two attractions were great, too. In fact, they've given me a new idea — an interactive magic show with a moving stage! We'll start working on it as soon as we've finished filming.

dialogues.speaker: Furina
dialogues.text: #Hehe. Why, hello there, {NICKNAME}, Paimon! I sensed your enthusiasm from a mile off.

dialogues.speaker: Furina
dialogues.text: You were so bright, I could've taken you for an opera singer in full falsetto!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Furina, you're finally here!

choices.text: Ah, our star has arrived!

response.speaker: Furina
response.text: Thank you, thank you. I am just as thrilled to be here as you are to have me.

response.speaker: Furina
response.text: ...More seriously, I'm not the star this time — that's you two, alongside all the creators sharing their passion for film with the world.

response.speaker: Furina
response.text: Honestly, when I was first asked to approve the plans, I thought this would just be a small event.

response.speaker: Furina
response.text: I never imagined that the Chevalmarin Film Fantasyland would expand to this scale so quickly...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Yeah... Thinking back to when we first arrived, it really has all come together in no time!

response.speaker: Furina
response.text: At this rate, who knows? Someday, it could become as iconic as the Fontinalia Film Festival itself!

response.speaker: Furina
response.text: And we have the two of you to credit for much of that!

response.speaker: Furina
response.text: I've suggested to several renowned directors that we award you the title "Pioneers of the Film Industry."

response.speaker: Furina
response.text: In contrast to the Furina Award, which is more of a public honor, this title is a mark of true recognition from within the industry itself — a reflection of both outstanding achievement and hard work!

choices.text: Thanks! But there's still room for improvement.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Wow, even you're getting serious now...

response.speaker: Furina
response.text: Come now, no need for any of that! Just relax and enjoy the moment.

response.speaker: Furina
response.text: Speaking of which, I've actually been preparing a little survey. How about we randomly select some visitors to give us feedback about the park?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Did Paimon hear that right? Furina, carrying out a customer satisfaction survey!?

response.speaker: Furina
response.text: Well, given that it bears the name of my dear friend Surintendante Chevalmarin, isn't it only natural that I conduct a bit of research on her behalf?

response.speaker: Furina
response.text: Besides, the more famous a star becomes, the more important it is to stay in touch with reality — no?

response.speaker: Furina
response.text: Plus, it's amazing how much you learn just by listening to other people's take on films!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Paimon always assumed celebrities just get their assistants to handle everything for them... but it sounds like it's actually pretty hard work.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Then again, maybe Furina's just an outlier...

choices.text: With great recognition comes even greater responsibility!
And now, the moment we've all been waiting for!

dialogues.speaker: Furina
dialogues.text: There we are, all set to go! Now, let's take a stroll nearby and randomly pick out some visitors to ask a few key questions.

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: Together with Furina, you gather a variety of suggestions and feedback from the visitors...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: These suggestions are surprisingly detailed... "Choosing film prototypes," "Recreating the scene cutting process," "Budget management for costumes, makeup, and set design"...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Paimon's head is spinning! Why is everyone so... professional!?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Also, nearly every single person we spoke to said they wanted to see Lady Furina perform! Your popularity is off the charts!

choices.text: No surprises there.

response.speaker: Furina
response.text: To tell you the truth, I've no plans to perform this time around.

response.speaker: Furina
response.text: Any star worth their salt knows their role.

response.speaker: Furina
response.text: When I take center stage, all the spotlights are on me, and rightly so. But as a guest, I should step back and let others shine.

response.speaker: Furina
response.text: So, instead of performing myself, I'd prefer to support you from behind the scenes. Perhaps as a consultant for one of your attractions, for instance...?

choices.text: Now that you mention it...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hey, that's right! Movie Masterpieces is all about film expertise. There really would be no better candidate than you!

response.speaker: Furina
response.text: Wonderful! Then I shall give this role my very heart and soul!

response.speaker: Furina
response.text: Once I've had a moment to prepare, we can meet up for a slice of gateau from my Patissiere Supreme before we get started!

choices.text: ...We've got the perfect role lined up!
I'd have said exactly the same thing.

dialogues.speaker: Furina
dialogues.text: Mmm, simply exquisite. As amazing as ever!

dialogues.speaker: Furina
dialogues.text: Escoffier, have you ever considered starring in your own film? Ah, I can see it now — "Valse en Cuisine," a riveting tale about the art of extreme cooking! I'm sure it would be a hit!

dialogues.speaker: Escoffier
dialogues.text: As it happens, I'm already doing something similar. A brand consultant has been filming my training sessions with students and incorporating them into films about Fontainian cuisine...

dialogues.speaker: Furina
dialogues.text: Oh, no. No, no, no, no. A documentary won't do. I'm talking about something with a bit more... drama! Your experiences as a chef could be turned into a scintillating story... In fact, I'll even write it myself!

dialogues.speaker: Escoffier
dialogues.text: Before you finalize it, please let me review the culinary terms — especially when it comes to how ingredients are handled, the timings, and the quantities...

dialogues.speaker: Furina
dialogues.text: Great. It's settled, then!

dialogues.speaker: Furina
dialogues.text: #And actually, I think I'd like to bring in {NICKNAME} and Paimon as directors. Something tells me that the three of you working together would really get the creative sparks flying. We could create something truly magical here!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: No problem! That said, now that we've been granted Director Furina's approval, we'll really have to step up our game!

choices.text: Director Furina, show us the way!

response.speaker: Furina
response.text: Excellent! I believe in you both!

response.speaker: Furina
response.text: The gateau was sublime as ever, Escoffier. Now, about time we got to work!

response.speaker: Furina
response.text: I'll start drafting the script on the side while serving as the consultant for Movie Masterpieces. Wish me luck!

choices.text: We may be rookies, but we'll give it our all!

dialogues.speaker: Furina
dialogues.text: A truly great adaptation must capture a film's core themes and seek to convey the inspiration that lies behind them...

dialogues.speaker: Furina
dialogues.text: The three attractions are certainly all up to par, and I trust that you'll be able to make them better still!

dialogues.speaker: Furina
dialogues.text: To enhance our film's aesthetic, I'd recommend a few classics for you to familiarize yourself with... Or, if you have the time, maybe we could watch them together?
